headline: Transform block-chord middle-register padding into five-part divisi counterpoint, staggered register spacing, and physical-model world string ostinatos across the Chora suite.
diagnosis: Severe low-mid energy congestion (250–800 Hz taking up to 82.5% of total spectrum in calm-glowmoss and over 60% across all energy cues) caused by 4-voice mid-register sustained block chords on single tracks.
Completely flat dynamic range (1.2 dB to 6.1 dB across all 10 looping cues), lacking human rubato swells, terraced dynamic shifts, and performDoc phrasing.
Stereo phase issues and negative correlation (-0.11 to -0.08) in all three energy gallops and battle cue due to monophonic brass/string doubling panned wide without delay compensation.
Underutilization of Chora palette: zero TONOS plucked/sympathetic textures or PNEUMA breath integration, relying on basic synth pads rather than sculpted acoustic-hybrid orchestration.
global: Establish standard 5-part string divisi across dedicated Chora LYRA tracks: Violins I (lyra-silk-strings, panned L35, C5-C7), Violins II (lyra-silk-strings, panned L15, G3-A5), Violas (lyra-viola, panned R15, C3-G4 with 4-3 and 9-8 suspensions), Celli (lyra-cello, panned R35, C2-E4), Double Basses (lyra-double-bass-arco, panned C, C1-C3 doubling Celli an octave lower).

Eliminate 4-voice sustained chord pads in the 250–800 Hz range; open up a 2-octave gap between Celli root notes (C2-F2) and Violin II/Viola counter-lines (F3-C4) to clear center register mud without using EQ.

Introduce TONOS gut/silk plucked ostinatos (tonos-kora, tonos-lute, tonos-koto, tonos-valiha) panned hard L/R as rhythmic propulsion, paired with performDoc rubato hairpins (p to ff swells of 8–12 dB dynamic excursion).
Enforce strict register pairing for brass/woodwind counter-melodies: French Horns (G2-E4) double Violas, Oboe/Flute (C5-G6) double Violin I octave up, Bassoon (F1-D3) doubles Celli pizzicato.

title.verdict: Expand single-line melody into an expansive late-Romantic orchestral sweep featuring TONOS kora arpeggios, divisi counterpoint, and soaring horn/violin unison.
moves: Bars 0–8: Assign Lantern Motif (C5-F5-G5-A5) to lyra-french-horn (F3-A4) doubled an octave higher by tonos-kora in 16th-note broken arpeggios; back with lyra-sul-tasto Violas sustaining F3-C4 suspensions resolving 4-3 to A3 at bar 4.

Bars 8–16: Split Violins into divisi; Violins I take high counter-melody (C6-Bb5-A5-F5) on lyra-silk-strings (panned L30), Violins II play descanting 8th-note runs (F4-A4-C5-F5), while lyra-cello plays descending counter-bass line (F2-E2-D2-C2).

Bars 16–24: Tutti climax (ff, dynamic range target 14 dB); lyra-trumpet-open and Violins I sing melody at C5-C6, supported by lyra-trombone stabs on beat 1/3 (F2-C3) and SOMA timpani-29-dresden rolls with bodhran-kerry-tipper drive.

calm-glowmoss.verdict: Clear the 82.5% low-mid mud by stripping block chords for delicate woodwind-string antiphony and warmth from tonos-kora-sesse.
moves: Bars 0–16: Keep note-for-note melody on lyra-clarinet (A4-G4-F4-G4-A4); replace block pads with tonos-kora-sesse playing 3/4 light plucked arpeggios (F3-C4-A4) and lyra-cello playing gentle bow-slurs on low roots (F2, D2, Bb1).

Bars 16–32: Transfer melody to lyra-concert-flute (A5-G5-F5) with lyra-oboe singing the Lantern Motif answer in counterpoint (C5-F5-G5-A5 at bars 19–20 and 23–24); back with soft lyra-sul-tasto string swell (p to mf, dynamic delta 10 dB).
Panning & Space: Pan Flute L15, Oboe R20, tonos-kora L40; route string section to FX1 Stone Chapel at 22% send for airy forest resonance.

calm-cascade.verdict: Transform Lydian waltz into a cascading impressionistic river scene using tonos-guzheng-glide, pneuma-hall, and high divisi violins.
moves: Bars 0–16: Preserve D Lydian melody on lyra-concert-flute (A5-C#6-D6-E6); introduce tonos-guzheng-glide playing downward cascading pentatonic runs (E6-C#6-B5-F#5-E5) on beat 3 of each bar.

Bars 16–32: Solo violin (lyra-concert-violin) takes melody in octave 5 with expressive vibrato; pneuma-hall provides airy background counter-swells on G#4-C#5, while lyra-cello plays high counter-lines (F#3-A3-D4).
Dynamic Shaping: Automate track volumes to create dynamic peaks at bar 10 (mf) and bar 26 (f), expanding dynamic range from 3.3 dB to 12.0 dB.

calm-keep.verdict: Craft a hushed, sacred moonlit ambiance using felt piano, tonos-lute, cantus-vault choir, and voice-led cello suspensions.
moves: Bars 0–16: Keep melody on lyra-felt piano (A4-F4-A4-Bb4); replace static pad with tonos-lute playing quiet polyphonic counterpoint (D3-A3-F4) and ison-bourdon drone on D2 (pp).
Bars 16–32: High cello (lyra-cello playing D4-F4-A4) takes the lullaby; back with cantus-vault choir performing 4-part minor suspensions (D3-F3-A3 to Eb3-G3-Bb3 at bar 18), resolving 9-8 on A3.
Lantern Motif Minor Transposition: Oboe enters at bars 31–32 playing minor motif (C5-F5-Ab5-A5) into soft hall decay (FX1 Grand Concert Hall).

energy-glowmoss.verdict: Convert flat, phase-opposed gallop into a crisp, driving classical scherzo with spiccato violins, tonos-bouzouki-tremolo, and SOMA taiko accents.
moves: Bars 0–16: Shift melody from plain horns to lyra-french-horn paired in unison with tonos-bouzouki-tremolo for woody, galloping bite; replace block pads with lyra-string-quartet spiccato ostinato (3/4 eighth-note pattern: F3-C4-F4).
Bars 16–32: Brass fanfare call; lyra-trumpet-open plays Lantern Motif (C5-F5-G5-A5) on beat 1 over lyra-pizzicato Basses (F1-C2-F2) and SOMA nagado-daiko-odaiko low accents on bar beat 1.
Stereo Fix: Re-pan Violins I (L35), Violins II (L15), Violas (R15), Trombones (R35) to fix negative correlation (-0.08 -> +0.45).

energy-cascade.verdict: Elevate Lydian gallop into a shimmering, high-speed orchestral sprint powered by tonos-kantele-bright, brass stabs, and SOMA field snare.
moves: Bars 0–16: Horns lead melody (A4-C#5-D5-E5); tonos-kantele-bright plays rapid 16th-note arpeggiated figures (D4-F#4-A4-C#5-E5) across 3 octaves to replace static ARP harp.

Bars 16–32: Violins I and Flute take melody an octave up (A5-C#6-D6); lyra-trombone delivers punchy marcato stabs on beat 1 & 2 (D2+A2), backed by SOMA orchestral-field-snare rim-shots and timpani-32-profondo strikes.
Dynamic Range: Introduce dynamic terracing—Bars 0–8 (mf), Bars 8–16 (f), Bars 16–32 (ff), broadening dynamic crest.

energy-keep.verdict: Build a heroic Gothic storm-waltz using dark brass, tonos-nyckelharpa bowing, SOMA bendir, and voice-led minor counterpoint.
moves: Bars 0–16: Horns and lyra-bassoon state D minor waltz melody; tonos-nyckelharpa adds gritty, sympathetic string friction on middle voice (D3-A3-F4).
Bars 16–32: Trumpets shout the Lantern Motif; lyra-bass-trombone and lyra-tuba execute heavy bass runs (D1-E1-F1-G1-A1), while SOMA bendir-atlas-gut provides a driving 3/4 frame drum rhythm.
Contrapuntal Voicing: Violas and Celli execute active counter-line in 8th notes (D3-F3-E3-D3-C#3-A2) beneath the trumpet theme.

danger.verdict: Transform static tension into a menacing Marianelli/Kilar bowed string suite with tonos-hardanger sympathetics and tar-nubian-deep pulses.
moves: Bars 0–8: Solo concert violin (lyra-concert-violin) plays expressive, weeping line (A5-Bb5-A5-F5); background sustained by VELA tremolo-strings (D2-A2-Eb3) and tonos-hardanger providing uncanny sympathetic resonances.

Bars 8–16: lyra-bassoon creeps in with minor Lantern Motif (D2-F2-Ab2-A2); SOMA tar-nubian-deep doubles pulse speed (accelerando feel), while lyra-alto-flute sighs on high note suspensions (A6 to G#6).
Spectrum Rebalance: Drop mid-register chord density; target sub_60 Hz boost via lyra-double-bass-arco low D1 swells.

fear.verdict: Create an unsettling 1-HP Phrygian countdown using pneuma-shakuhachi breath, ticking lyra-pizzicato, and low bowed cello menace.
moves: Bars 0–8: Low lyra-cello states Phrygian motif (A2-D3-Eb3-F3); pneuma-shakuhachi introduces pitch-bent breath accents on Eb4; lyra-pizzicato wood-ticking provides relentless 16th-note clock texture.

Bars 8–16: lyra-french-horn takes theme an octave higher (A3-D4-Eb4); VELA cathedral pad and hushed cantus-plainsong choir swell underneath (p to f); SOMA concert-gran-cassa delivers low sub-thuds (D0) on measure 9 and 13.
Harmonic Tension: Hold Eb in lower voices against D minor root, creating razor-sharp 4-3 and b9-8 suspensions.

battle.verdict: Turn boss theme into a towering cinematic war-waltz with bowed celli menace, brass counter-calls, tonos-sarangi, and full SOMA taiko battery.
moves: Bars 0–16: Horns & Trombones state D minor war motif (A3-D4-F4); lyra-cello and lyra-double-bass-arco play aggressive bowed ostinato (D2-D2-D2-C#2); tonos-sarangi adds wild eastern string glissandi over brass.

Bars 16–32: Violins I/II and Trumpets take soaring lead; Trombones answer with minor Lantern Motif in canon 1 bar later (D2-F2-G2-Ab2); SOMA nagado-daiko-odaiko, bendir-atlas-gut, and timpani-32-profondo roll in ff peak.
Phase & Correlation Fix: Hard-pan Violin sections L35/L15, Brass R35/R15, SOMA drums C/L20/R20, pushing stereo correlation from -0.11 to +0.55 and crest factor above 22 dB.

clear.verdict: Deliver a brilliant, triumphant 11-second fanfare with soaring woodwinds, tonos-qanun flourishes, and full brass resolution.
moves: Bar 1: Trumpet, Flute, and Violins play bright Lantern Motif (C5-F5-G5-A5-C6) in broad heroic legato; Horns provide warm mid-foundation (F3-A3-C4).
Bar 2: tonos-qanun and lyra-harp execute sweeping ascending 32nd-note glissando across 4 octaves (F3 to F7) leading into final chord.
Bar 3: Tutti hold on Fmaj9 (F1+C2+F3+A3+C4+E4+G5); SOMA timpani roll resolves with concert-gran-cassa final strike.

gameover.verdict: Craft a poignant, tear-jerking resolution using felt piano, tonos-koto, lyra-english-horn, and fading string quartet decay.
moves: Bars 1–2: lyra-felt piano plays falling motif (A5-G5-F5-D5) with soft mechanical pedal noise; tonos-koto echoes each note softly 1 octave higher.
Bars 3–4: lyra-english-horn takes over final phrase (Bb4-D5-E5-F5); lyra-viola and lyra-cello sustain final F major triad with gentle bowing decay (dynamic drop from p to ppp).
Final Decay: Allow Stone Chapel hall reverb (FX1) to carry tail over 6 seconds after last note cut off.

mustKeep: The game-wide LANTERN MOTIF (sol·do–re–mi / C5·F5 G5 A5 in F major) and its modal transformations (minor in danger/boss, Phrygian in fear).
The exact note-for-note core melodies of the three stage lullabies (calm-glowmoss, calm-cascade, calm-keep) loved by Kenne.
Seamless game loop boundaries (exact tempo, clean bar transitions, stem crossfade compatibility between calm, energy, danger, and fear).
Strict compliance with Kenne's palette rules: zero bell-type voices, celestas, or metallic struck glass patches.
